initiatives.name: Amplify GA Collaborative
initiatives.description: Coalition of reproductive health, rights, and justice organizations working to protect and expand abortion access across Georgia.

initiatives.name: Asian American Advocacy Fund
initiatives.description: A Georgia 501(c)(4) political group based in Norcross that endorses candidates, runs multilingual voter outreach, and advocates for Asian American and Pacific Islander communities.

initiatives.name: Poder Unides
initiatives.description: Trans-led group in Atlanta that provides MARTA cards, interview clothing, job training, mentorship, mutual aid and counseling for trans, Black, Indigenous and Latinx people.

initiatives.name: Georgia Latino Alliance for Human Rights (GLAHR)
initiatives.description: An Atlanta-based nonprofit, founded in 2001, that educates and organizes Latino immigrants across Georgia to defend their civil and human rights.
